# aidial_catalog_schema (Resource)

Manages a DIAL Core catalog schema (`PUT /v1/catalog_schemas/{bucket}/{path}`): a JSON Schema document that models reference through `catalog_schema_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aidial_catalog_schema" "model" {
  path = "model"

  schema = jsonencode({
    "$id" = "https://dial.epam.com/catalog-schemas/model"
    type  = "object"
    properties = {
      vendor     = { type = "string" }
      parameters = { type = "string" }
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Catalog schema path inside the target bucket.
- `schema` (String) The catalog schema as a JSON object string (use `jsonencode`). Must contain a non-blank `$id`.

### Optional

- `bucket` (String) Target DIAL bucket. Defaults to "platform" when not set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `schema_id` (String) The `$id` of the schema; use it as a model's `catalog_schema_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <bucket>/<path>.
terraform import aidial_catalog_schema.example platform/model
```
